name: Michelle C. Kim
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division One

items.text: Michelle C. Kim has been an associate justice of the California Court of Appeal, Second District, Division One, since 2024. From 2018 to 2024, she was a Los Angeles Superior Court judge, and previously an alternate public defender. As a Superior Court judge, she was an assistant supervising judge. Her published opinions cover employment law and civil procedure. She is vice chair of the Los Angeles Judicial Selection Advisory Committee.
